strategy_roster.name: Squeeze Momentum Indicator
strategy_roster.entry_long: bb_upper(close,20,2) > ema(close,20) + 1.5 * atr(high,low,close,20) and roc(close,1) > 0 and close > ema(close,100)
strategy_roster.notes: Bollinger(20,2) is compared with an EMA(20) plus 1.5-ATR(20) Keltner proxy, while positive ROC and EMA(100) alignment represent momentum. Linear-regression momentum and squeeze-color state are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Triangular Hull Moving Average
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(40) and its two-bar ROC provide a transparent proxy for the documented two-bar-lag HMA comparison. HMA itself, direction filters, and short entries are not representable.

strategy_roster.name: RSI MA Trend
strategy_roster.notes: Because only parameter names are supplied, RSI(14), buy/sell levels 30/70, and SMA(10)/SMA(30) are explicit fallbacks; the long rule and neutral/trend-loss exit are retained. Short entries and exact optimized values are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: VQZL Z-Score
strategy_roster.notes: The documented threshold 1.64 and 100-bar z-score are directly represented; the opposite threshold supplies the long exit. The separate 15-bar price smoothing and short branch are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Basket Close Utility
strategy_roster.notes: The utility has no natural signal; the documented optional test buy is represented by a bullish candle and a bearish candle exits. Portfolio-wide PnL thresholds, optional test orders, and multi-instrument flattening are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Monthly Returns
strategy_roster.notes: Prior two-bar extrema are a practical proxy for the documented pivot highs and lows; the opposite range break exits. Pivot confirmation bars, monthly accounting, and the short side are not expressible in the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: MACD Sample 1010
strategy_roster.notes: The source's contrarian lower-band close is translated as a long entry with Bollinger(4,2), and a middle-band recross is a reversion exit. The three-pip band buffer, pip profit/loss, lot scaling, and opposite sell side are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Robust EA Template
strategy_roster.notes: CCI is unavailable, so a strongly negative z-score(20) approximates the negative CCI ranges while retaining the documented RSI(14)<25 condition. CCI/period defaults, pip stops, and the short branch are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Pending Stop Grid
strategy_roster.notes: A prior ten-bar range break is a stateless proxy for the two pending stop ladders; the mirrored low break exits. Ladder spacing, volume multiplication, pending-order state, and point-based protection are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: CCI Slope Mean Reversion
strategy_roster.notes: CCI and its slope lookback are unavailable; a cross above the -2 z-score boundary with a rising normalized value proxies the reversal entry, and normalization at zero exits. The documented 2% stop is retained; short and exact slope settings are omitted.
